In 2024, we contracted an additional 19 GW of new renewable energy across 16 countries,
further diversifying our energy portfolio. Microsoft also expanded into nuclear energy with
the signing of our first large-scale nuclear energy PPA with the Crane Clean Energy Center
in September 2024. This agreement will enable the restart of  an 835-MW nuclear facility
in Pennsylvania, retired in 2019, providing a significant supply of new, reliable, CFE to the
PJM power grid—a critical energy region for Microsoft’s datacenters.
